adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... })` but does not attach a `.catch(...)`. Unlike the `save()` action (which explicitly `.catch(popupAjaxError)`), a failed DELETE request would result in an unhandled rejected promise and no UI error feedback. The diff also shows server-side `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#destroy` does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then `host.destroy` without a nil check, which can produce a 500 if `host` is nil—exactly the kind of failure that would be swallowed client-side due to the missing catch.
